description: Na₇Al₃O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are seven inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.88 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three AlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one AlO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.40 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.72 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four AlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.36 Å. In the fifth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.69 Å. In the sixth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.36 Å. In the seventh Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.88 Å. There are three inequivalent Al³⁺ sites. In the first Al³⁺ site, Al³⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three AlO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.78 Å. In the second Al³⁺ site, Al³⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two AlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.80 Å. In the third Al³⁺ site, Al³⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three AlO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.78 Å. There are eight inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₅Al octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-59°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and two Al³⁺ atoms. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Al octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-59°. In the fourth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and two Al³⁺ atoms. In the fifth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and two Al³⁺ atoms. In the sixth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom. In the seventh O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na¹⁺ and two Al³⁺ atoms. In the eighth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom.
